title: Web Development Workshop
speaker: Harshil Patel (Senior Frontend Architect)
description: Hands-on session on modern web development with industry experts covering React, Tailwind CSS, and scalable architecture.
longDescription: Dive deep into modern frontend engineering with interactive coding challenges, component-driven development, state management, and deploying robust applications to modern cloud providers.

title: Introduction to AI/ML
speaker: Dr. Ananya Sharma (AI Researcher & Consultant)
description: An engaging seminar on the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning pipelines, and generative models.
longDescription: Explore fundamental algorithms, neural network foundations, computer vision, and the latest trends in Large Language Models. Includes live interactive demonstrations of transformer models.

title: ACM Hackathon 2025
speaker: Mentors from Google, Microsoft & Fast-Growing Startups
description: A 24-hour hackathon to build innovative solutions for real-world problems with prizes worth over ₹50,000.
longDescription: Join over 40 teams collaborating overnight to solve real-world community challenges in Smart Education, Healthcare, Web3, and Sustainable Tech with round-the-clock mentorship and delicious snacks.

title: Cloud & DevOps Bootcamp
speaker: Vikram Desai (DevOps Lead)
description: Learn containerization with Docker, CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, and cloud deployment on AWS.
longDescription: From code commit to automated zero-downtime production deployment: build CI/CD pipelines, containerize backend microservices, and deploy securely with container registries.

title: ICPC Sprint & Algorithms Camp
speaker: ACM CP Committee Leads
description: Sharpen your problem-solving skills with competitive programming drills, graphs, and dynamic programming.
longDescription: A timed speed programming contest followed by comprehensive editorial analysis and whiteboard problem teardowns for national coding contests.

title: Git & Open Source Summit
speaker: ACM AMTICS Core Contributors
description: Master Git workflows, create pull requests, and contribute to production open source software.
longDescription: Demystifying Git rebasing, branch protection, open source licensing, and making your first impactful contribution to world-class repositories.
